payload.claim: No test checks `rdfs:label` on any `data:phase-...` node, even though criterion 5 explicitly requires the phase node to be "labelled with the phase name by rdfs:label". test_an_attempt_states_its_phase_number_turns_cost_and_times checks the phase's rdf:type and prov:wasInformedBy but never its label, so deleting this line changes nothing the suite observes.
